n77bb7686ea.headline: Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has wiped out a third of global helium supply, and the scramble for secure alternatives has begun
n77bb7686ea.summary: Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has wiped out a third of global helium supply, and the scramble for secure alternatives has begun. Six ASX-listed companies could be affected.
n77bb7686ea.why: Helium is used in MRI scanners and semiconductor manufacturing, so supply shocks ripple into healthcare and the AI chip supply chain.

n871662102e.headline: Market Shocks, War Fears & Volatility: Why Staying Invested May Be The Only Winning Strategy?
n871662102e.summary: ICICI Bank reported a stronger-than-expected rise in fourth-quarter profit, driven by robust loan growth and lower provisions for bad loans, according to a Mumbai report on April 18.
n871662102e.why: ICICI Bank is one of India's largest private lenders, so its results signal the health of India's credit cycle.

n15b43ae69c.headline: India May Continue Buying Russian Oil, Gas Even After End Of US Waiver
n15b43ae69c.summary: India may keep buying Russian crude oil and LPG after a one-month US sanctions waiver expires, the report said. The waiver will not be extended, according to the article.
n15b43ae69c.why: India is a large crude importer, and its purchases of discounted Russian oil affect global crude flows and sanctions compliance.

n16949657d1.headline: Zelio E-Mobility appoints 26-year-old CA as CEO after IPO debut
n16949657d1.summary: Zelio E-Mobility's board approved the appointment of a 26-year-old chartered accountant as chief executive. The appointment followed a recommendation from the nomination committee, after the company's IPO debut.
n16949657d1.why: Zelio E-Mobility is an Indian electric-vehicle company, and leadership changes after a listing can affect investor confidence in its strategy.

n288e1196fe.headline: Pirelli hikes prices to cushion the impact of Middle East crisis
n288e1196fe.summary: Italian tyremaker Pirelli is combining price increases with cost-cutting to limit the effect of geopolitical tensions on its earnings. The strategy aims to protect profitability amid the Middle East crisis.
n288e1196fe.why: Pirelli is a global premium tyre manufacturer, and its margins depend on raw material costs such as oil-derived inputs and on pricing power with automakers and consumers.

n89a7c9b4b8.headline: RBI pulls out ₹2 lakh cr transient liquidity via 7-day VRRR auction
n89a7c9b4b8.summary: The Reserve Bank of India withdrew ₹2 lakh crore of transient liquidity through a 7-day variable rate reverse repo auction. The central bank accepted higher bids at competitive rates.
n89a7c9b4b8.why: The Reserve Bank of India manages system liquidity and short-term rates, which feed into money-market yields and bank lending costs.

nd3a0f60def.headline: How the Insolvency code is evolving, and resolutions could be faster under new proposals - BusinessToday
nd3a0f60def.summary: Proposed changes to India's insolvency code would require resolution within 150 days, extendable by 45 days. The current process allows 330 days.
nd3a0f60def.why: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code governs how distressed Indian companies are restructured or liquidated. Faster timelines affect creditor recoveries and banks' bad-loan resolution.

n6ad5c38d02.headline: Finolex Cables looking to increase its North East presence driven by govt's infra, electrification push
n6ad5c38d02.summary: Finolex Cables aims to grow in Northeast India, driven by government infrastructure initiatives and rising demand for electrical products. The expansion targets a region benefiting from public works spending.
n6ad5c38d02.why: Finolex Cables is an Indian manufacturer of electrical wires and cables, so its sales track construction and power infrastructure spending.

na2a3612806.headline: Rupee ends stronger, trims underperformance versus Asia FX on RBI measures
na2a3612806.summary: The Indian rupee rose on Friday after a Reuters report of a central bank step to curb state-run oil companies. The move trimmed its underperformance against Asian currencies.
na2a3612806.why: The Reserve Bank of India manages the rupee and foreign exchange reserves. State-run oil companies are large dollar buyers, so their demand strongly influences the currency.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The rupee rose on the central bank step, as the report states.

nfbdb5e6a32.headline: Fuel for Malaysians first
nfbdb5e6a32.summary: Malaysia will meet its own fuel requirements before supplying any excess fuel to Australia, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said. The statement comes amid fuel supply concerns.
nfbdb5e6a32.why: Malaysia is a regional petroleum product exporter, and its supply priorities affect fuel availability in neighbouring markets such as Australia.

ne25b671672.headline: What CGT changes would mean for Melbourne landlords, renters - realestate.com.au
ne25b671672.summary: More than 120 Melbourne suburbs could be affected if the government changes capital gains tax rules, according to realestate.com.au. The article examines impacts on landlords and tenants.
ne25b671672.why: Capital gains tax affects investment property returns and therefore housing supply and rental markets in Australia.

n85567f77e2.headline: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia ink deal to extend $3bn deposit
n85567f77e2.summary: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia have signed an agreement extending the maturity of a $3 billion Saudi deposit, witnessed by Finance Minister Aurangzeb on the sidelines of the WB-IMF Spring Meetings.
n85567f77e2.why: Saudi deposits support Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves, which are closely watched by investors in its sovereign debt and rupee.

nf5c8c34589.headline: Rupee Starts Climbing Towards 277/US$ After Another Increase to End Week
nf5c8c34589.summary: The Pakistani rupee closed higher against the US dollar on Friday, extending its run of gains to a 142nd consecutive day, and posted gains against most other currencies.
nf5c8c34589.why: A steady rupee affects Pakistan's import costs and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Pakistani rupee
impacts.why: The rupee closed stronger against the US dollar on the day reported.

n218639abda.headline: Gasoline could drop below $4 in coming days
n218639abda.summary: Gasoline costs should start to fall soon, though a full recovery to pre-war prices is expected to take months, assuming peace holds and traffic resumes through the Strait of Hormuz.
n218639abda.why: Gasoline prices feed directly into US consumer inflation and household spending.

n29393baac2.headline: Iran halts petrochemical exports amid strikes, prioritises domestic supply
n29393baac2.summary: Iran has imposed a total ban on petrochemical product exports as it works to safeguard internal supplies following strikes. The report describes the measure as a priority for domestic needs.
n29393baac2.why: Iran is a major petrochemical producer, and export restrictions can tighten global supply of chemicals used in plastics and industrial goods.

source.name: The Sentinel - of this Land, for its People

sources.name: The Sentinel - of this Land, for its People

n9cad055d50.headline: Rupee rises 29 paise to settle at 92.85 against US dollar
n9cad055d50.summary: The rupee touched a low of 92.98 before ending the session at 92.85 provisional against the dollar, up 29 paise from the previous close.
n9cad055d50.why: The rupee's exchange rate against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and the returns foreign investors earn on Indian assets.

n177f878829.headline: The Strait of Hormuz opens for commercial ships but the U.S. blockade continues on Iran
n177f878829.summary: Iran's foreign minister declared the Strait of Hormuz open after an Israel-Lebanon ceasefire began. President Trump said the US naval blockade on Iran will continue.
n177f878829.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil transit chokepoint, so shipping access there directly affects global crude supply and prices.
n177f878829.why_moved: Iran declared the strait open for commercial shipping, but the US said its blockade on Iranian ports and shores would continue, leaving the supply outlook uncertain.

n741de3f891.headline: Why Strategy Stock Leaped Almost 12% Higher on Friday
n741de3f891.summary: Strategy shares jumped almost 12% on Friday, and the company is described as a leveraged play on bitcoin that benefited from the cryptocurrency's rise.
n741de3f891.why: Strategy is a US company that holds large amounts of bitcoin, so its share price tends to move with bitcoin.

nbd28403d44.headline: Casual jobs drive New Zealand's employment growth amid external pressure
nbd28403d44.summary: A new report shows strong employment growth in casual roles in New Zealand, amid external economic pressure.
nbd28403d44.why: Employment trends shape consumer spending and the labour market that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand monitors for interest-rate decisions.

nc79c511c7f.headline: Why Autoliv Stock Rocked the Market on Friday
nc79c511c7f.summary: Autoliv, an auto safety systems company, published its first earnings report of 2026, and its stock rocked the market on Friday. The article gives no figures.
nc79c511c7f.why: Autoliv is a major global supplier of airbags and seatbelts to car makers, so its results signal conditions in the auto parts supply chain.

impacts.name: Autoliv
impacts.why: The company's first quarterly results of 2026 drove a notable share price reaction.

n4e8ecc1262.headline: Rupee regains 92 levels, closes 27 paise higher
n4e8ecc1262.summary: The rupee regained the 92 level and closed at 92.93, 27 paise stronger than its previous close. Reports said the RBI had asked banks for something, according to the article.
n4e8ecc1262.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects India's import costs, inflation, and foreign investor returns, and the Reserve Bank of India manages its volatility.

nb127195ac5.headline: Oil companies, exporters, importers cheer Hormuz Strait opening
nb127195ac5.summary: Indian oil companies, fertiliser importers and exporters are welcoming the opening of the Strait of Hormuz to global commercial vessels.
nb127195ac5.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for Gulf oil and LNG shipments, so its status affects global energy supply and prices.

nd305dde51b.headline: Mideast energy output may take about 2 years to recover: IEA chief
nd305dde51b.summary: Fatih Birol, head of the International Energy Agency, said recovering energy output lost in the Middle East from the conflict will take about two years.
nd305dde51b.why: The IEA is the energy agency that advises major oil-consuming countries, and its supply assessments shape energy market expectations.

nd5f32fe2c4.headline: Compromises abound in PM's global hunt for extra fuel
nd5f32fe2c4.summary: As fuel supplies tighten, world leaders, including Australia's prime minister, are making difficult choices about where to source fuel. Details of the choices are limited in the summary.
nd5f32fe2c4.why: Fuel supply shortages affect transport costs, inflation and energy security for importing economies such as Australia.

nd1364df49f.headline: India's first maritime-focused lender eyes $1 billion FY27 fundraise
nd1364df49f.summary: India's first maritime-focused lender, Sagarmala Finance Corp, targets $1 billion of fundraising by FY27. The funds are intended to enhance port and shipbuilding lending.
nd1364df49f.why: Port and shipbuilding finance supports infrastructure and trade capacity, and maritime lenders channel capital into a sector often underfunded by banks.

nb116cbf3c2.headline: Europe Is on the Brink With Only About Six Weeks of Jet Fuel Left: IEA Energy Chief Issues Dire Warning
nb116cbf3c2.summary: The International Energy Agency's energy chief warned Europe may have only about six weeks of jet fuel left, with flight cancellations possible. The warning links the shortage to the Iran conflict and the Strait of Hormuz closure.
nb116cbf3c2.why: The IEA is the energy agency of major consuming nations, and jet fuel supply shortfalls affect airlines, airports and refiners.
nb116cbf3c2.why_moved: A warning of only about six weeks of jet fuel left, linked to the Strait of Hormuz closure, raises supply-shortage concerns in Europe.

n5dd0828260.headline: Marcos suspends LPG, kerosene excise taxes for 3 months
n5dd0828260.summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. approved a three-month suspension of excise taxes on LPG and kerosene. The move aims to cushion Filipino households from rising fuel prices.
n5dd0828260.why: Excise taxes are levied on fuels and their suspension lowers retail prices, which directly affects household energy costs and inflation.

nd50a796dca.headline: Smartphone sales see weakest quarter in 6 years
nd50a796dca.summary: India's smartphone market opened 2026 on a weak note, with shipments slipping 3% year on year. It was the slowest start in six years.
nd50a796dca.why: Smartphone demand is a key indicator for consumer electronics and the component supply chain, including chipmakers and handset brands.

n59a44e7062.headline: Dollar set for second weekly drop, euro steadies near pre-war levels
n59a44e7062.summary: The U.S. dollar was on track for a second consecutive weekly decline, while the euro and British pound steadied around pre-war levels. Investors were unwinding positions.
n59a44e7062.why: The dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and its moves affect commodity prices, global capital flows and multinational earnings.

nb6a53ddc36.headline: Strait of Hormuz is fully open, Trump and Iranian foreign minister say
nb6a53ddc36.summary: President Trump and Iran's foreign minister said the Strait of Hormuz is now fully open to commercial vessels. The announcement follows a ceasefire in Lebanon.
nb6a53ddc36.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow waterway through which a large share of global seaborne oil and LNG passes, so its status directly affects energy supply and prices.
nb6a53ddc36.why_moved: Both sides' statements that the strait is open reduce the perceived risk of supply disruption through the Gulf. The input notes a US naval blockade on Iran continues, which limits the scope of the reopening.

nb7dae4cacf.headline: How 50 days of the Iran war led to the loss of $50 billion worth of oil
nb7dae4cacf.summary: Global oil markets have lost over 500 million barrels worth nearly $50 billion since the Iran conflict began. Gulf supply disruptions have tightened inventories, and analysts expect a slow recovery.
nb7dae4cacf.why: Oil is the benchmark energy commodity, and inventory tightening from supply disruptions feeds into fuel prices, inflation and corporate costs worldwide.

n0e0b6b1161.headline: US to delay weapons deliveries to some European countries due to Iran war, sources say
n0e0b6b1161.summary: Some European counterparts have been told that select US weapons deliveries may be delayed. Sources say the Iran war continues to draw on US weapons stocks.
n0e0b6b1161.why: Defence contractors such as Lockheed Martin and RTX depend on US and allied procurement schedules, and delivery timing affects their revenue.

n5811e66b69.headline: Iran reopens Strait of Hormuz, but Trump says blockade on Iranian ships and ports will stay in force
n5811e66b69.summary: Iran said it fully reopened the Strait of Hormuz to commercial vessels. President Trump said the US blockade on Iranian ships and ports will remain in full force until a deal is reached.
n5811e66b69.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there directly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
n5811e66b69.why_moved: The reopening announcement eases supply fears, while the continued US blockade keeps uncertainty over Iranian exports unresolved.

nf45bd7025f.headline: As Iran Reopens Strait of Hormuz, Are U.S. & Iran Near Deal or Renewed Fighting?
nf45bd7025f.summary: President Trump said a deal to end the Iran war is 'very close', with direct talks possibly resuming in Pakistan. The Pentagon is surging thousands of additional troops to the Middle East.
nf45bd7025f.why: Escalation or a deal between the US and Iran directly affects Gulf oil supply, shipping routes and global energy prices.

nd9bad7e42e.headline: Traders place $760 million bet on falling oil ahead of Hormuz announcement
nd9bad7e42e.summary: Traders placed about $760 million in bets on falling oil just before updates on the Strait of Hormuz and Iran. The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is scrutinising the trades.
nd9bad7e42e.why: The CFTC oversees US derivatives markets, and its scrutiny of trades ahead of policy news bears on market integrity in oil futures.

nb756703847.headline: Trump Says ‘No Sticking Points’ for Iran Deal
nb756703847.summary: Donald Trump told AFP there were no sticking points left for a peace deal with Iran and that an agreement was very close, after posts touting progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
nb756703847.why: A US-Iran agreement could ease oil supply risks in the Gulf and affect energy prices and regional risk premiums.
nb756703847.why_moved: Statements that a deal is close and that Hormuz is being reopened reduce expectations of prolonged supply disruption.

n51abb913b0.headline: Ripple (XRP) Leads Weekly Crypto Gains as Altcoins Outperform Bitcoin
n51abb913b0.summary: XRP rallied about 10% this week from $1.33 to $1.50, outperforming Bitcoin's roughly 7% gain and Ethereum's rise of about 9%.
n51abb913b0.why: XRP is the token of the Ripple payments network, and its price moves reflect wider risk appetite in the crypto market.

nd2515670e2.headline: Oil prices drop 13%, Dow soars after Iran reopens the Strait of Hormuz
nd2515670e2.summary: Oil prices fell 13% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average surged after Iran said the Strait of Hormuz is fully open. The reopening eases concern over key shipping flows.
nd2515670e2.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly move crude prices and risk sentiment across equities.

impacts.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
impacts.why: The Dow rose sharply on the same reopening news, per the report.
